page: Amazon Web Services i8ge.24xlarge is a storage-optimized server powered by 96 dedicated AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 cores running at 2.8 GHz. Built on the Nitro hypervisor, this arm64 instance features 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core. The hardware configuration is highlighted by a massive 60,000 GB local NVMe SSD storage array and a high-speed 150 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Multi-core performance is highly competitive, scoring in the top tier for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth is also exceptionally strong, with cached read-only small block and uncached large block read/write operations placing in the top ten percent. However, single-core performance remains in the average tier across stress-ng and Geekbench single-core benchmarks.

Given its massive sixty-terabyte local NVMe SSD storage capacity and top-tier database operations performance, this instance is highly cost-efficient for data-dense, storage-heavy workloads. It is optimized for large-scale databases, high-throughput static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing pipelines that require high resource density without the need for dedicated GPU acceleration.
